title: AWS - Cloud Integration
description: Cloud integration dashboards for Amazon Web Services, collected by the Wazuh aws-s3 module. CloudTrail dashboards cover API activity, IAM and access changes, console sign-ins, denied calls and security-relevant configuration changes; GuardDuty dashboards cover findings by severity and type, and network threats such as port probes and brute force. Enable CloudTrail dashboards on the customer's cloudtrail-<customer_code>* event source and GuardDuty dashboards on guardduty-<customer_code>* (or one event source covering both).
